title: asm-audit-finding: clmul wrappers spill to out-of-line _mm_extract_epi64 due to missing sse4.1 target_feature
description:
## Finding

The retrospective asm audit (`dev/bench_results/2026-04-27-asm-audit.md`, issue `bd00d76a`, commit `afff922`) discovered that four `pclmulqdq`-gated wrappers in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/` cannot inline the `_mm_extract_epi64` intrinsic and instead emit out-of-line calls into `core::core_arch::x86_64::sse41::_mm_extract_epi64`, with the resulting stack-spill / register-marshalling trampoline executed twice per scalar product (six times for one Barrett step):

| Wrapper | File | Asm artefact lines | # out-of-line calls per call |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clmul_u64` | `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/clmul.rs:38` | `clmul.asm.txt:28,33` | 2 |
| `clmul_batch_sequential` (called from `clmul_batch` fallback path) | `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/clmul.rs:115` | `clmul.asm.txt:95,100` | 2 per element |
| `clmul_barrett_reduce` | `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/clmul.rs:210` | `clmul.asm.txt:315,320,343,348,360,365` | 6 |
| `clmul_wide4_xmm` | `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/gf2m_wide.rs:48` | `gf2m_wide.asm.txt:47,53,65,70,81,86,96,101,112,117,127,132,141,146,158,164,177,182,194,200,213,218,227,232,244,249,260,265,278,284,294,299` | 32 (16 scalar products × 2 halves) |

## Suspected cause

`_mm_extract_epi64` requires the `sse4.1` CPU feature. The wrapping functions only declare `#[target_feature(enable = "pclmulqdq")]`, which does not transitively imply `sse4.1`, so the compiler refuses to inline the SSE4.1 intrinsic into the wrapper's feature scope and falls back to a non-inlined call into `core::core_arch::x86_64::sse41::_mm_extract_epi64`. Each call spills the `xmm` accumulator to the stack via `movdqa xmmword ptr [rsp + offset], xmm` immediately before the call site, then reloads on return — observable directly in the asm artefact.

The vpclmul / avx2 cousins (`clmul_batch_vpclmul`, `clmul_wide4_ymm`) inline correctly because their `#[target_feature(enable = "avx512vl", enable = "vpclmulqdq")]` and `#[target_feature(enable = "avx2", enable = "vpclmulqdq")]` clauses give the inliner enough context to emit `vextracti128` + `vpextrq` directly without crossing the SSE4.1 boundary.

## Suggested fix

Add `enable = "sse4.1"` to the `#[target_feature]` attribute of:

- `gf2_kernels_simd::x86::clmul::clmul_u64`
- `gf2_kernels_simd::x86::clmul::clmul_batch` (top-level dispatch — covers the sequential fallback inlined into it)
- `gf2_kernels_simd::x86::clmul::clmul_batch_sequential`
- `gf2_kernels_simd::x86::clmul::clmul_barrett_reduce`
- `gf2_kernels_simd::x86::gf2m_wide::clmul_wide4_xmm`

The detect functions in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/{gf2m,gf2m_wide}/mod.rs` should also gate on `is_x86_feature_detected!("sse4.1")` (in addition to `pclmulqdq`) before publishing fn pointers to these wrappers, though in practice every x86_64 CPU shipped with PCLMULQDQ also has SSE4.1 (Westmere ≥ 2010), so this is largely a belt-and-braces correctness gate.

After the fix, regenerate `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/asm/clmul.asm.txt` and `gf2m_wide.asm.txt` via `dev/scripts/regen-asm.sh` and confirm the `call core::core_arch::x86_64::sse41::_mm_extract_epi64` lines have been replaced by inlined `pextrq xmm, ..., 0/1` (or equivalent `pshufd`+`movq` shape on rustc's discretion).

## Expected impact

Removing the calls turns each scalar `pclmulqdq` step from ~12-instruction stack-spill+call+ret sequence into a single `pclmulqdq` followed by 2 `pextrq`. Direct measurement is left to the fix issue, but the geometry is roughly:

- `clmul_u64` body: ~8 instructions before fix → ~4 after (≥1.5× speedup on the scalar lane).
- `clmul_wide4_xmm`: 16 spill+call pairs eliminated → expected ≥2× kernel-asymptote uplift.
- `clmul_barrett_reduce`: 6 spill+call pairs eliminated per call.

All affected wrappers are on inactive cold paths when VPCLMULQDQ is available (the `clmul_batch` dispatcher tail-calls `clmul_batch_vpclmul` on AVX-512VL hosts), but they are the active path on every Westmere–Haswell host without VPCLMULQDQ — which is the platform the `_xmm` / scalar fallback is named for. The Barrett wrapper is hot regardless because it is the chosen single-element scalar path for `BarrettReducer::reduce_with_clmul` even on VPCLMULQDQ hosts (no vectorised Barrett yet).

## Out of scope for this bug

- Adding a vectorised Barrett path.
- Re-tuning the cpuid dispatch threshold for VPCLMULQDQ vs scalar.
- Touching `clmul_batch_vpclmul` or `clmul_wide4_ymm`, which already inline correctly.

## Acceptance

1. Diff adds `enable = "sse4.1"` to the five wrappers listed above.
2. `dev/scripts/regen-asm.sh` reproduces fresh `clmul.asm.txt` and `gf2m_wide.asm.txt` artefacts with zero `call core::core_arch::x86_64::sse41::_mm_extract_epi64` occurrences.
3. `cargo nextest run -p gf2-kernels-simd --release --profile ci` passes (existing test_vectors and proptest harnesses cover the equality-with-scalar oracle).
4. `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` clean.
